title: Leadership roadmap synthesis and Q2 executive briefing
creator: Noah Kim
description:
Consolidate product, engineering, and design inputs into a concise executive briefing for the Q2 leadership sync and upcoming board QBR. Deliver a 12-15 slide packet that highlights: progress against top-level OKRs, three strategic bets for the quarter, measurable runway (cost/latency improvements), key risks with mitigation plans, and specific asks from the executive team (budget, hiring, partner approvals). Use recent runtime telemetry, Dedicated capacity adoption metrics, and early Private deployment pilots as evidence.

Goals:
- Align cross-functional leadership on priorities and trade-offs for Q2.
- Surface hard decisions and resource requests clearly so board/executive reviewers can act.
- Produce an actionable one-page summary for post-QBR follow-ups.
deliverables: readout speaker notes and talking points
acceptance_criteria: Slides reviewed and approved by Head of Product and VP Eng
All data points linked to dashboards or Confluence pages
Asks formatted with owners, cost, and timeline
Packet exported to PDF and uploaded to Drive with access for Board members
